phase_prompt.summary: Standard crystalline and chrome manifestation with fiber-optic robes.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Full body shot of Archangel Raphael standing tall, composed of chrome plating and solidified light. He wears vestments of flowing fiber-optic cables. His face is a faceted crystal mask. Cool blue and cyan lighting illuminates the translucent parts of his frame. High-tech ancient aesthetic, photorealistic, volumetric lighting.
